1.text: Zaburi iyi ni indirimbo yo kuririmbwa ku isabato.

2.text: Ni byiza gushima Uwiteka,No kuririmbira izina ryawe ishimwe, Usumbabyose,

3.text: Kwerekana imbabazi zawe mu gitondo,N'umurava wawe uko bwije,

4.text: Tubwira inanga y'imirya cumi na nebelu,Tubwirisha inanga ijwi ry'uwibwira.

5.text: Kuko wowe Uwiteka, wanyishimishije n'umurimo wakoze,Nzavugishwa impundu n'imirimo y'intoki zawe.

6.text: Uwiteka, erega imirimo wakoze irakomeye!Ibyo utekereza bifite uburebure bw'ikijyepfo.

7.text: Umuntu umeze nk'inka ntazi ibi,Umupfu ntabimenya.

8.text: Iyo abanyabyaha bārutse nk'ibyatsi,Kandi inkozi z'ibibi zose iyo zeze,Ni ukugira ngo barimbuke iteka,

9.text: Ariko wowe Uwiteka, ushyizwe hejuru iteka ryose.

10.text: Dore abanzi bawe Uwiteka,Dore abanzi bawe bazarimbuka,Inkozi z'ibibi zose zizatatanywa.

11.text: Ariko washyize hejuru ihembe ryanjye nk'iry'imbogo,Nsīzwe amavuta mashya.

12.text: Kandi ijisho ryanjye ryarebye ibyo nshakira abanzi banjye,Amatwi yanjye yumvise ibyo nshakira abanyabyaha bampagurukiye.

13.text: Umukiranutsi azashisha nk'umukindo,Azashyirwa hejuru nk'umwerezi w'i Lebanoni.

14.text: Ubwo batewe mu rugo rw'Uwiteka,Bazashishira mu bikari by'Imana yacu.

15.text: Bazagumya kwera no mu busaza,Bazagira amakakama menshi n'itoto,

16.text: Kugira ngo byerekane yuko Uwiteka atunganye,Ni we gitare cyanjye, ntarimo gukiranirwa na guke.
